title: OSD assembly descriptor 0.6
description: A firmware a person runs, as its builder wrote it: a stock firmware and the modules applied to it, in order, each by its catalogue id and its exact version. Its MIDI is the stock firmware's followed by what each module adds. The builder of the firmware writes it; OSD never builds, checks nor chooses one.

assembly.description: The assembly itself, as a descriptor (with its $schema) or as a sound's made_on (without it).

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

stock.description: The stock firmware, pinned: the catalogue id of its descriptor (kind firmware or application) and its exact version.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

firmware.description: The catalogue id of the stock firmware's descriptor (a firmware descriptor of kind firmware or application).

version.description: The exact version of the stock firmware.

modules.description: The modules applied to the stock firmware, in the order they are applied, each pinned at its exact version. May be empty.

^_.description: A note for people; never read by a program.

module.description: The catalogue id of the module's descriptor (a firmware descriptor of kind module).

version.description: The exact version of the module the assembly pins.
